name: Aranyosapáti (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Aranyosapáti: a quartered blue and white shield with a figure, a tree, an apple and a wavy stripe, above a scroll inscribed ARANYOSAPÁTI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
